claims.claim: Mativational, business, relationship and self development books
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show multiple motivational/business/self-help/relationship-themed book covers (e.g., “Zero to One”, “This Is Marketing”, “Bringing Out the Best in Your Marriage”, “Women Rise Up”).

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show covers laid out and no obvious water staining, but there are no close-ups of page edges/spines or open pages to confirm internal cleanliness/dryness or “sorted”.

claims.evidence: No certified scale label, weighing screen, or photo/video of the weighing process is shown in the provided images. Seller’s text assertion is not proof.

risks.risk: Actual quantity/weight may be far less than claimed (500 kg), changing value per kg.
risks.proof: A clear photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full bundle on it, showing the scale brand/certification label and the timestamp.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a smaller mixed bundle of used books (worst case: not 500 kg).

risks.risk: Books may have internal damage (torn pages, mold/odor, heavy foxing) not visible on covers.
risks.proof: Close-ups of spines and page edges + open 2–3 random books to show inner pages (no mold spots/tears).
risks.if_unproven: Price as used books with possible wear (worst case: not guaranteed clean/dry internally).

risks.risk: Set may not match what buyer expects (duplicates, low-value editions, missing titles), affecting resale.
risks.proof: A full inventory list or a video panning across all books showing titles/editions clearly, plus total count.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an average mixed bundle (worst case: many common/low-demand titles).

risks.risk: Condition level (new vs fairly used vs heavily used) is uncertain from distance shots.
risks.proof: Photos of corners, spine condition, and one open page each for 5 random picks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as fairly used condition (worst case: not near-new).

proof_requests: Please send a photo/video of the weighing: certified scale label + the full bundle on the scale + the final reading (with timestamp).
Send close-ups of 5 random books: spine + page edges + one open page each to confirm no mold/tears/soiling.
Send a count or a clear title list/video showing all books so we can confirm the exact set.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is only an assertion; without new photos/video of the certified weighing and internal condition, the key pricing drivers (500 kg and cleanliness) remain unverified from remote evidence.
